meta.name: teach-impeccable
meta.description: One-time setup that gathers design context for your project and saves it to your AI config file. Run once to establish persistent design guidelines.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存项目设计规范到AI配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI助手记住你的项目设计偏好
copy.tagline_en: Save project design guidelines to AI config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI to remember your project design preferences

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先扫描项目代码库，然后询问你关于用户、品牌和设计偏好的问题，最后将设计上下文写入 CLAUDE.md 文件，使后续对话始终遵循这些设计准则。
howto.when: 当你首次为项目设置设计指南时触发。通常在你要求 Claude 开始设计工作之前运行一次。

say.text: 请帮我收集这个项目的设计上下文。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并提问。

say.text: 为我的 React 应用建立设计准则。
say.note: Claude 会询问品牌和用户信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans the project codebase, asks you about users, brand, and design preferences, then writes the design context to CLAUDE.md so all future sessions follow those guidelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you first set up design guidelines for a project. Typically run once before starting design work.

say_en.text: Please gather design context for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will scan code and ask questions.

say_en.text: Set up design guidelines for my React app.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about brand and users.
